title: The share rule told the number of flows, pushing against the capacity in use, on the truth, on validation links
description: Told the number of flows N on the true LCFs, the share rule u = 0.125 - log2(N) + k busy max(0, 1 - N receive/capacity) trades as k grows: k = 4 beats the fixed rule with copies and with a Cubic flow from the start but not alone, larger k wins against Cubic and loses with copies and alone (exp-fairshare-val-21, exp-fairshare-k-val-22). Its push also fires when a flow alone is not yet using the link. This variant (experiments/share_rule_export.py --flows N --used) compares the flow's share with 1/N of the capacity in use: u = 0.125 - log2(N) + k max(0, 1 - N receive/(busy capacity)), so a flow alone or a copy at its fair share never pushes. k in {2, 4, 6, 8}, read from the guest's truth, next to the k = 4 rule above, the fixed rule on net1 v4 (u = 0.125) and BBRv3, in the same links and conditions (experiments/fairshare.py, seed 11, the 21 validation links): alone for 20 s, with a Cubic flow from 0 s for 60 s, and 2 or 4 copies for 30 s. N is given per episode, so this is an upper bound for a net1 that would estimate it.
prepare: G="$IN/grid/$(cat "$IN/grid/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v4" "$G" --u 0.125; for n in 1 2 4; do uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/fair" "$G" --u0 0.125 --k 4 --flows $n --oracle; uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/fair" "$G" --u0 0.125 --k 2 4 6 8 --flows $n --used --oracle; done; P=(--policy "rule-v4=$OUT/v4/rule-u0.125.onnx"); for n in 1 2 4; do P+=(--policy "fair-oracle-k4@$n=$OUT/fair/share-u0.125-k4-n$n-oracle.onnx"); for k in 2 4 6 8; do P+=(--policy "used-oracle-k$k@$n=$OUT/fair/share-u0.125-k$k-n$n-used-oracle.onnx"); done; done; uv run python experiments/fairshare.py "$OUT" --split val --seed 11 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" && uv run python experiments/copies_report.py "$OUT"
